niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, spacious, clearly structured interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, rounded controls, and soft branded accents. They consistently like centered compositions, grouped content, scannable text, generous spacing, subdued or blurred backgrounds that isolate the main content, and polished lightweight controls. They also respond positively to visible imagery or artwork, simple clear iconography, and warmer or purple-accented palettes over darker, harsher, or more cluttered presentations.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers layouts with a centered focal point, clear titles/headlines, distinct grouping of related content, and stronger separation between sections so the main message is immediately obvious.
Prefers generous padding, open spacing, balanced margins, and lighter content density rather than cramped or crowded arrangements.
Prefers rounded buttons and polished control treatments with softer, more balanced emphasis rather than harsher or boxier actions.
Prefers blurred, subdued, or imagery-based backgrounds that create a calmer mood and help foreground content stand out over darker or more distracting backdrops.
Prefers softer branded accent colors, especially purple and warm orange, over cooler, harsher, or muddier accent treatments.
Prefers content broken into shorter, more digestible units such as subtitles, bullets, and concise sections instead of dense paragraphs or overly complex presentation.
Prefers prominent, clearly visible artwork or simple high-clarity icons/illustrations rather than faint, abstract, missing, or visually busy imagery.
